title: Notifications

empty.title: You're all caught up
empty.description: Requests, changes to your access and finished jobs show up here.
empty.unread: No unread notifications. Switch to All to see earlier ones.

loadError: Your notifications could not be loaded.

requests_and_invitations.label: Requests and invitations
requests_and_invitations.description: Someone asks to join your experiment or organization, or invites you to an organization.

membership_and_access.label: Membership and access
membership_and_access.description: A request of yours is decided, your access or role changes, or people join or leave what you run.

experiments_and_resources.label: Experiments and resources
experiments_and_resources.description: Something you work on is made public, deleted, moved, or has a new workbook version.

devices_and_calibration.label: Devices and calibration
devices_and_calibration.description: A calibration run waits for your approval, or a run you started is approved or rejected.

project_transfers.label: Project transfers
project_transfers.description: Your PhotosynQ project transfer is received or completed.

data_jobs.label: Data exports and uploads
data_jobs.description: An export or upload you started finishes or fails.

account_security.label: Account security
account_security.description: Someone adds an API key or a passkey to your account.
